scope: Working completed expressions. Every row fixes a reading; these are not unique dictionary meanings or an exhaustive subject grammar.
comparison_note: The older concept matrix tests one primary sense per word. It is not a verdict on every completed expression. Universal inclusions and explicit disjointness can pass to subclasses; a refuted broad inclusion cannot.
groups: A realized change that is better under a fixed baseline and standard.
A prescribed way of seeking betterment; success is not part of membership.
Formation or elaboration of a structure or capacity, including worsening cases.
Development whose resulting change is better under the same stated standard.
A realized increase in a specified intelligent capability under fixed tasks, conditions, baseline, and standard.
An occurrence of preserving an intelligent capability within a specified tolerance over an interval; increased capability is not required.
Assessment of a specified intelligent capability through stated observations and inference rules.
A condition specifying the intelligent capability an activity requires under stated supports and circumstances.
An experience-dependent lasting change in an intelligent capability; the change is not assumed beneficial.
An experience-dependent lasting change that improves the specified intelligent capability under an unchanged standard.
An ability to bring a specified class of new items into existence under stated conditions.
An intentionally produced new item considered as the result of a creation process.
A lasting experience-dependent change considered as the temporal process in which it occurs.
A realized improvement in a learning process or capacity, with the target and criterion fixed.
An actual transition among specified claims, questions, assumptions, or possibilities.
A repeatable prescription for making specified intellectual transitions.
A change that makes something available to a specified inquirer relative to a fixed earlier position.
An assessment of what is newly available, to whom, relative to which baseline.
An ability to use the relevant relations to distinguish, explain, or handle specified cases.
A process that forms or elaborates that capability, with the domain and conditions fixed.
The ability to generate materially different possibilities under stated conditions.
Assessment of that generative ability from specified tasks and evidence.
An authored expression fixing what is being considered, its referents, and relevant boundaries.
A verdict about which explicitly defined scopes or classes a specified matter satisfies.
A specification of an intended outcome and its achievement conditions.
An operative choice of which specified goal to adopt, defer, reject, or reopen.
An agent's contextual favoring of alternatives or features.
A change that makes a preference pattern available to an inquiry; the hypothesis may still need testing.
A stated ground of worth by which alternatives deserve consideration.
Assessment of what happens when specified grounds of worth favor incompatible alternatives.
A particular assessment that reaches or revises a verdict under stated grounds.
A realized improvement in a judgment process or its verdict quality under a fixed standard.
An act that adopts, rejects, defers, withdraws, or reopens an operative option.
An account of the reasons and conditions on which a specified decision depends.
A specification of the distinction requested, relevant referents, assumptions, and resolution conditions.
The process of constructing a new question specification, with question identity fixed.
An actual exploration of candidate locations or possibilities for a stated target.
A proposed policy determining where, how, and when a later search proceeds.
A disposition to find out about a specified matter, independent of whether it is pursued.
An occurrence of acting on curiosity about a specified matter.
A sustained inquiry organized around specified matters and revisable findings.
A proposed arrangement of research questions, dependencies, and possible continuations.
A field of practices investigating empirically examinable accounts.
A particular sustained empirical inquiry within such a field.
A field investigating concepts, grounds, implications, and fundamental questions.
A particular sustained investigation of a specified conceptual or foundational matter.
An operation that identifies or formulates a particular obstruction or unmet requirement.
A repeatable prescription for identifying or formulating obstructions and unmet requirements.
An activity directed toward removing a specified difficulty, regardless of success.
A realized improvement in the means or results of solving the specified class of problems.
An account of how a specified occurrence depends on stated conditions or factors.
The process of constructing a new textual explanatory account.
A representation of an outcome made before that outcome is available to the predictor.
Assessment of a prediction against its stated outcome, horizon, and scoring criterion.
An expression specifying what must hold for a particular assertion to be true.
A verdict about whether what an assertion says holds under its fixed interpretation.
A position in which specified alternatives remain unresolved for an agent or inquiry.
A transition in which fewer specified alternatives remain unresolved; warrantedness is separately assessed.
Possession of true content with adequate grounds under a declared account of knowing.
An expression presenting attributed knowledge, which need not itself establish knowledge.
The relation through which specified earlier material is available to later work.
An operation that makes retained material operative in a current task.
An intentionally produced expression that stands for specified content or distinctions.
An intellectual process that determines the content or distinctions an expression represents.
A specified relation linking terms or positions.
A change that makes a previously unavailable relation available to a specified inquiry.
A contribution relation between material and a specified concern under stated circumstances.
Assessment of whether and how material contributes to a specified concern.
An allocation of operative focus among available contents or activities.
A condition specifying the operative focus required for a particular task under stated supports.
A relation between a specified means and the uses for which it is available under conditions.
An assignment of specified means, capacity, or access to uses.
The activity of arranging prospective actions, dependencies, and contingencies.
A proposed arrangement of prospective actions, dependencies, and contingencies.
An authored proposed policy governing later action under conditions.
An operative choice among specified candidate policies.
An occurrence of doing under an agent's direction or control.
A proposed arrangement for what actions to take and under which conditions.
A process of addressing contributions for interpretation in a specified interaction.
Assessment of how well intended distinctions survive interpretation in that interaction.
The process of constructing or revising text.
An authored text considered as an expression rather than its production process.
Writing whose subject matter is a specified technical domain.
A repeatable method for constructing or revising text; its topic can be nontechnical.
An act of addressing a model with instructions or context to influence its work.
An authored instruction or contextual expression prepared for a model.
The label has no adopted meaning; no completion or marketing interpretation is supplied.
Developing or assessing candidate form and requirements against intended use and feasibility.
An authored expression specifying a proposed form, its requirements, and relevant conditions.
An organization of interacting components considered through joint behavior or function.
The process of arranging interactions or compatibility among specified components.
A bounded purposeful undertaking with coordinated work and intended results.
An authored collection of files recording or implementing some of the undertaking.
A specified repeatable way of performing work.
A particular occurrence of work that follows the specified method.
An authored organization of concepts, distinctions, and relations for further work.
An occurrence of using that organization to address a specified matter.
An agent-directed occurrence of employing specified means for a result.
An assessment of instrument indications against stated reference conditions.
An authored artifact supplied or used for a specified operation.
A process that forms or elaborates the tool's structure or capabilities.
An occurrence unfolding through an ordered course over time.
An expression representing the stages, events, or dependencies of a process.
An identifiable process transforming or selecting material under stated conditions.
A repeatable prescription fixing inputs, transformation, and occurrence conditions.
The retained ability to perform specified work under specified conditions.
An occurrence in which that ability is exercised.
The specified way in which terms or positions stand to one another.
An expression representing a relation and its argument positions.
A difference between fixed earlier and later states or positions.
An operation identifying a difference between specified positions or states.
An intentionally produced item considered as the result of specified work.
Assessment of a specified result against fixed criteria and context.
An intentionally produced item or expression.
A process maintaining the identity and relevant properties of an artifact over time.
A representation used to examine or derive consequences about a specified target.
An occurrence of operating a specified executable model with stated inputs.
An organized domain of investigative concerns and practices.
A sustained inquiry into a specified matter within such a domain.
A class whose members satisfy stated membership conditions.
A verdict that a specified item or class satisfies stated membership or containment conditions.
An assessing operation determining status or comparative merit under stated criteria.
A stated ground of merit used in a specified assessment.
Arranging interactions or compatibility so specified components can function together.
A condition that the intended joint functioning of components must satisfy.
A configuration in which specified work runs without repeated local human selection.
A process forming or elaborating such a configuration.
Improvement where the system producing or governing the change is also the target that improves.
A prescribed way for a system to seek its own improvement; success is not implied.
Organized activity intended to develop another agent's understanding or capabilities.
Assessment of what changed in a learner and whether the educational activity warrants attribution.
Multiple agents coordinating contributions to shared work.
An authored expression of the participants' roles, commitments, and coordination conditions.
An assignment of specified means or access to uses under conditions.
A proposed arrangement of later assignments of means or access to uses.
A specified arrangement of elements and relations.
A specified alteration from one arrangement into another.
An operation resolving which alternative or subset is used, retained, or adopted.
A repeatable prescription governing how alternatives are selected under conditions.
A condition restricting admissible actions, configurations, or results.
Assessment of whether a specified candidate satisfies the exact constraint.
A relation through which a result becomes available to influence subsequent work.
An operation that uses an available prior result to select or transform current work.
A change specified through how a target is altered into another state or arrangement.
A repeatable specification of how to produce such an alteration.
Writing whose represented subject matter is art; the writing need not itself qualify as art.
Producing a new artwork through the construction of text.
An artwork that represents or investigates writing; it may use a nontextual medium.
Assessment of the artistry of a specified text or writing practice under stated criteria.
